observations: body L3, L19, L23: the hairlines of some letters did not print: the n of «concavam» and the o of «interiorem» (L3) and the last o of «momento» (L19) and of «rotatio» (L23) show separate strokes; transcribed as the letters.

body L4, L20: the last digit of «٢١٢» (L4) is 3.0 points wide with one crest, that of «٢١٣» (L4) 4.4 points with two crests; the 2 and the 1 of «٢١٢» touch (4.3 points). In L20 the digits of «١٩٢» and the first two digits of «٢٢٣» have one crest each (2.9-3.1 points), the last digit of «٢٢٣» two crests (4.4 points).
body L6: «und» is printed in the quotation from Lane, for the English conjunction; transcribed as printed.
body L9: the kasra of «وسَمِّ» is printed below the tail of the final mīm, the shadda above it.
body L9, L12, L17, L25: «ذلك» (twice, L9), «انها» and «عدد» (L12), «الأَعْزَل» (L17) and «دائرة» (L25) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.
body L10: the mark under «الفضلتيْن» is the two dots of the yāʾ run together (3.5 by 1.7 points), not a kasra; the sukūn over the yāʾ is the narrow sort (2.2 by 3.1 points).
body L10: the first «Muḥ» and «Aḥmad» are letter-spaced (gaps of 2.3-2.7 points); the second «Muḥ.» at the end of the line is set solid (gaps of 0.7-1.0 point); transcribed as printed.

body L10, L11: «aṣ–Ṣabbāgh» (L11) is printed with an en dash 5.0-5.3 points long that touches both letters, as aṣ–Ṣūfī on p. 329; «al-yawāqīt» (L11) and «lxxix-lxxx» (L10) have hyphens (3.2-3.5 points).
body L12: «لا» is printed without an alif before the lām-alif (for الا); transcribed as printed.

body L13: the full stop after the quotation of L11-L13 stands at the right end of L13, after the Arabic line in the order of the Latin text. The spaced dots of «ابدًا ... وهي» are transcribed «...». The kasra under the nūn of «قِسْمانِ» touches its bowl; the mīm has no vowel sign.
body L16: «Πάρϑενος» is printed with the acute on the alpha and none on the epsilon; transcribed as printed. «السُّنْبُلَةُ» has a damma on the tāʾ marbūṭa.
body L17, L18: the first «سنون» of L18 has no vowel signs; the mark above it is the kasra under the sīn of «السِّمَاك» (L17).

body L17, L24, L25, L26: the middle digit of «٢٥٩» (L17) is a closed loop (5); the middle digit of «١٦٤» (L24) and «١٦٥» (L25) has the hook of a 6 at its upper left (3.1 and 2.9 points wide), and the last digit of «١٦٤» is a 4 (3.8 points). The zero of «١٥٠» (L26) touches the 5 and sits on the baseline (1.7 by 1.9 points), as the zero of ٣٠ on p. 337 (1.8 by 1.9 points).

body L18, L20: «anni» (L18, L20) prints heavier than the rest of the italic (stems 1.4-1.6 points against 1.1-1.3), with the letter shapes of the ordinary italic; transcribed in italic, not as the bold italic of ken- on p. 335.
body L20: the full stop after «(cfr. II, 295)» is printed raised, 3.4 points above the baseline (1.7 by 1.8 points); transcribed as a full stop.
body L22: a comma-shaped stroke (1.5 by 3.5 points) is printed below the baseline after «similitudinem», 1.5-2 points lower than the commas of the page; not transcribed.

body L23, L24: «السّنَوِيّ» (L23) has the shadda alone on the sīn, «السَّانَوِيّ» the shadda with a fatha. The marks above «الشمس» (L24) are the tail and the dots of the yāʾ of «السّنَوِيّ»; «الشمس» has no vowel signs.
